name: ble_input_test
title: BLE Input Test
description: Diagnostic receiver for testing PAX BLE keyboard, mouse and gamepad input.
author: PAX workspace
about: Experimental diagnostic app for the PAX NANO BLE Test peripheral and compatible PAX BLE receiver firmware. It records input counts and connection status to /sd/roms/pax/ble_input_test.json. This is a test utility, not a general-purpose BLE pairing app.
controls: Shows BLE connection and keyboard, mouse, gamepad input
changelog: 0.1.0: add the BLE HID diagnostic receiver for PAX BLE test peripherals.

requires.note: Folder for the BLE input JSON report
